eventDetail.scope: The scope of Image Processing Applications is vast and highly specialized. Medical image processing remains a fundamental research pillar. Mechanical applications and precision measurement rely heavily on these systems. Robotics and autonomous systems use vision for navigation and interaction. Digital twins create virtual replicas of physical assets for simulation. Furthermore, vision technologies power smart city infrastructure. This includes automated waste management and traffic congestion optimization. These diverse fields demonstrate the broad reach of the conference. Industry is rapidly integrating Image Processing with AI-based solutions. Current research focuses on large-scale industrial deployment. These systems must meet complex real-world implementation criteria.  Edge AI deployment is a critical frontier. Modern hardware requires highly optimized solutions. Knowledge distillation techniques help compress complex models. Pruning methods further reduce computational demands.
